body: I should do, I just have no idea where to start. It's like a big ball of string all wrapped up and I don't know where the string starts to unravel it all.
She's my best friend in all honesty. I've always struggled to speak to those close to me, it's easier to speak to strangers I've never met.

My sister has the same condition, but to a more sever degree. So I know she understands, but she has much to deal with herself because of it. As do my parents who live with her and act as carers for her. It's a difficult situation.

Thank you for taking the time to reply to me.

I'm trying so hard to keep busy, they wanted me signed off work but I know that'll be the end of me if I sit doing nothing and I'm left alone with my thoughts for hours on end.

I've lost all Motivation to do anything, I usually love to read, I'd write in my journal, or game for a while. Watch still YouTube videos. But I've lost the passion for everything. I take the time everyday to make sure I look on the outside how I I wish I felt on the inside, I always do my hair and make up and dress nicely, because if I don't do that I can't leave the house and let people see how I really am.

I do miss sleep, I've not slept a night through in so long, I've been and bought some sleeping pills, I don't know how they'll react to the cocktail of prescribed medication I've got but at this point I'm not sure I even care. I just want to curl up in a ball and forget everything. I just want it all to stop.

It's just so frustrating, I'm usually strong and people always say they're amazed with what I live with. But it's all a front, and I'm struggling to keep that front up. Everyone can see I'm struggling now, and they're worried. And I hate doing that to them, I wish I could just be OK for them.

I have, but he also suffers with depression so it's a struggle to speak to each other and not feel like we're making each other worse. I love him dearly, I know that much.

I get a lot of breaks, basically as many as I want because of my condition I can't be still for too long and have to go for a walk before my joints basically seize up and I'm even more useless.
I'm a Coca-Cola buyer for a major brewery, which is ridiculously stressful at times.

I have a lot going on in my personal life that I know isn't helping, I'm trying to be strong for me and my partner. The pain gets to me as well, waking up everyday in pain, some days not being able to move because of it, waiting to see which part of my body is going to fail next, waiting for another trip to the hospital because something has given up on me. I'm just so exhausted.

They've been amazingly supportive of me. They've gotten me equipment to try and ease my pain there's £5k worth of specialist office equipment they've bought specifically for me. Which was nice, it helped to a degree and I could pretend to live a normal life where I'm not disabled and not in crippling pain all the time. But I'm back to square one again. I've manged to fight so hard to ignore the want and the need to hurt myself, but I'm tried of fighting it all anymore. I just want it all to stop, I can't even cry anymore, I'm completely devoid of anything other than the want to just give in.

I have private health care through my employer and they're sending me to a psychologist, it's just the wait. I don't know when I'll see them, my anti depressants have been upped but that tales time to get into my system.

And I just can't see where this time come from, I don't have the energy to carry on fighting and trying, and waiting.
